rows.note: For sense 1, this is the all-purpose choice for something radically new or likely to bring major change.

example.english: This invention is truly revolutionary and will completely change our lives.
example.traditional: 呢個發明真係好革命性，會徹底改變我哋嘅生活。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 faat3 ming4 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaak3 ming6 sing3 wui5 cit3 dai2 goi2 bin3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 saang1 wut6

rows.note: Use this for the political sense, referring to a revolution in government rather than an innovative product or idea.

example.english: Those people put forward revolutionary ideas and wanted to overthrow the existing government.
example.traditional: 嗰班人提出革命嘅主張，想推翻現有政府。
example.jyutping: go2 baan1 jan2 tai4 ceot1 gaak3 ming6 ge3 zyu2 zoeng1 soeng2 teoi1 faan1 jin6 jau5 zing3 fu2
